title: [Broadcom-DNX]: ECN config cannot be disabled with CLI and error logs seen while enabling/disabling ecnconfig for a queue-ID.
author: amitpawar12
body:
### Is it platform specific

broadcom

### Importance or Severity

High

### Description of the bug

admin@ixr-x3b-14:~$ date; sudo ecnconfig -n asic0 -q 3 on

6. Reporting the issue for the generation of the ERROR log.

### Steps to Reproduce

Enable and disable the ECN config as shown in step (1) and (3) above.

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

I think the CLI does not effect at all and no bearing on ECN configuration. However, no error logs should be generated.

comments.author: rlhui

comments.author: saksarav-nokia
comments.body:
For VOQ systems, the QUEUE section of the config_db uses the system ports even for local ports.
However EcnQ.set in ecnconfig sonic-utilities cli python script, it gets all the ports from DEVICE_NEIGHBOR table and adds " | Queue-num" as key to set/delete the wred_profile in the QUEUE table of config_db. Since orchagent code expects the key should be host-name| asic-name| port | queue format  (4 tokens)_and this cli command sets port | queue with 2 token, the error message is printed and the orchagent ignores the set/del command.
Setting the wred-profile in config_db*.json works fine.

#### What I did
 Set ECN ON/OFF for all the Voq's in the asic in the Voq system to fix https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/22856
#### How I did it
 The existing code was setting ECN ON/OFF for only local front panel ports Voq's. However in the Voq system, the ECN should be ON/OFF for all the Voqs in the namespace including the Voq's of the remote asics.
#### How to verify it
Verified the ECN functionality in the Voq chassis.
